//: Presence spaces: a space is occupied while ANY of its Zigbee2MQTT sensors sees someone, clear once ALL are.
//sensors: IEEE addresses, not Z2M friendly names, so renaming a device in the Z2M UI doesn't unwire it. Add a sensor to a large space by appending its address.
//eisy: eisy is the index into EISY_URLS (0-4): the EISY whose Zigbee Presence plugin shows this space as a node.
//var: Optional: varType (1 = integer, 2 = state) + varId make this service also keep that EISY variable at 1/0. Only for spaces whose programs still read a variable instead of the plugin node.
